item.text: [{"task_id":"1a6449f1","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    inset = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    minimum = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    if inset <= 0 or minimum <= inset + inset:","        return grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    best_area = 0","    result = grid.copy()","    for top in range(height):","        for left in range(width):","            color = int(grid[top, left])","            if color == background:","                continue","            for bottom in range(top + minimum, height + inset):","                if bottom > height:","                    continue","                if not np.all(grid[top:bottom, left] == color):","                    continue","                for right in range(left + minimum, width + inset):","                    if right > width:","                        continue","                    area = (bottom - top - inset - inset) * (right - left - inset - inset)","                    if area <= best_area:","                        continue","                    if not np.all(grid[top, left:right] == color):","                        continue","                    if not np.all(grid[bottom - inset, left:right] == color):","                        continue","                    if not np.all(grid[top:bottom, right - inset] == color):","                        continue","                    best_area = area","                    result = grid[top + inset:bottom - inset, left + inset:right - inset].copy()","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,1,3]},"rationale":"Find complete monochromatic rectangular frames excluding the background, select the frame with the largest interior area, and return its interior without the border. Tensor entries encode background color, border inset, and minimum frame dimension."}]
